title: The trial standard of proof
summary: The persuasion burden determines how convincingly a party must establish its claim or defense to the factfinder. The assigned discussion distinguishes preponderance, clear and convincing evidence, and proof beyond a reasonable doubt.
notes: A higher standard affects evidentiary sufficiency without authorizing credibility findings at summary judgment.

sections.Meaning: The persuasion burden determines how convincingly a party must establish its claim or defense to the factfinder. The assigned discussion distinguishes preponderance, clear and convincing evidence, and proof beyond a reasonable doubt.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the applicable standard for the particular issue. Under Anderson, use it to ask whether a reasonable jury could find for the nonmovant; do not replace the jury by deciding whether the judge personally believes the evidence.
